train.kind: unchanged prior P3 real AdamW factual prequential trainer
train.saved_state: model optimizer recurrent fast_weights history sampler rng

assay.tested_checkpoint: saved step80 (frozen weights; no additional optimizer updates in this assay)
assay.prequential_evaluation: same C4 read-only evaluation: 16 alternating factual actions per regime, zero sensor, elapsed 0.2, cloned checkpoint state per query
assay.causal_order: predict first on each current prefix action, then reveal only that action's realized factual consequence; no future outcome, counterfactual or latent label may enter predictor
assay.prefix_actions: alternating -1,+1 starting at first prefix action; identical actions and elapsed time across all arms
assay.prefix_origin: fresh copy of original step80 native state for every arm and length
assay.no_feedback: advance original recurrent/history on exactly the same actions using model.step, but never call learn_outcome or reveal any outcome to it; not compute matched
assay.matched_factual_controls: old_factual and recent_factual have identical original model, native state, action count, read/write operations; only observed outcomes differ
assay.read_only_eval: no outcomes or optimizer gradients during evaluation; read-only, same fixed probes after prefix
assay.source_of_truth: per-seed receipt with exact native checkpoint parent hashes and canonical SHA256 of raw squared error vectors

limits: This is public repeated familiar algebraic DEV evidence, not heldout or novel transfer.

Old/recent regimes are indistinguishable without observed outcomes; no latent labels go to the predictor.
The native model does not have trained context-indexed memory; results are mechanism diagnostics.
No complete fully trained conventional matched control or scientific first use.
No live owner, accepted pointer, backing store, FORGE or science-state changes.
